name: Original acquired Retort: cold inventory, quality readback and inventory inspection

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 1280
resolution y = 720
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = false

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

at 0 command dynamic:player:0000000000000001 GetAV Health
at 0 command content:oblivion.esm:04e936 GetStage

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local t=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died inspecting acquired Retort')
 local inv=types.Actor.inventory(self)
 print('RetortDrop stock='..inv:countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0xc4f))..' health='..types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current)
 for _,obj in ipairs(inv:getAll()) do if obj.recordId==core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0xc4f) then
  assert(types.Apparatus.objectIsInstance(obj),'Inventory Retort facade type changed')
  local record=types.Apparatus.record(obj)
  assert(record.type==3 and record.quality==10 and record.weight==3 and record.value==50,'Original Retort properties changed')
  print('RetortDrop original properties type=3 quality=10 weight=3 value=50')
 end end
end}}}}
